speaker: Councilor

raw: [name="Councilor"]  How are we supposed to get anything done in a strategic planning session without you?
speaker: Councilor

speaker: Severin
content: What's the situation?

speaker: Councilor
content: The Infected are still protesting. They've even started chasing off Infected newcomers.

speaker: Severin
content: What do they want?

speaker: Councilor
content: They... they believe the fire was part of some kind of plot. They demand an explanation for Dr. Atro and the dead Infected.

speaker: Severin
content: A plot? An explanation? Great, someone must be riling them up.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Even the Infected wouldn't stoop that low. Most of them are from Wolumonde.
speaker: Severin
content: Even the Infected wouldn't stoop that low. Most of them are from Wolumonde.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Have they had any contact with that militant group out there?
speaker: Severin
content: Have they had any contact with that militant group out there?

speaker: Councilor
content: None, for now.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  But the militants have been lingering around the outskirts of the hamlet. I'm worried they might influence the protestors.
speaker: Councilor
content: But the militants have been lingering around the outskirts of the hamlet. I'm worried they might influence the protestors.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  Just a second, it's from the sentry—
speaker: Councilor
content: Just a second, it's from the sentry—

content: Go ahead.

speaker: Councilor
content: Two? Infected?

raw: [name="Councilor"]  They claim to be from Rhodes Island? I know that name—
speaker: Councilor
content: They claim to be from Rhodes Island? I know that name—

raw: [name="Severin"]  That would be Dr. Atro's company. *Sigh.* We knew this was coming.
speaker: Severin
content: That would be Dr. Atro's company. *Sigh.* We knew this was coming.

speaker: Councilor
content: Wh-what do we do?

raw: [name="Severin"]  Dr. Atro was a respectable Infected. They may be here looking for her. And they have a right to know the truth.
speaker: Severin
content: Dr. Atro was a respectable Infected. They may be here looking for her. And they have a right to know the truth.

speaker: Severin
content: Let them in.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  ...You heard him. Do as he says.
speaker: Councilor
content: ...You heard him. Do as he says.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  Hmm, are you sure about this? What if they have something to do with the militants out there?
speaker: Councilor
content: Hmm, are you sure about this? What if they have something to do with the militants out there?

raw: [name="Severin"]  Between the Great Rift, the fire, and the Infected, do we have the luxury to be suspicious of everyone who knocks on our door?
speaker: Severin
content: Between the Great Rift, the fire, and the Infected, do we have the luxury to be suspicious of everyone who knocks on our door?

raw: [name="Councilor"]  What about after they learn the truth? What if Rhodes Island seeks reparations from us? How much is Wolumonde to suffer?!
speaker: Councilor
content: What about after they learn the truth? What if Rhodes Island seeks reparations from us? How much is Wolumonde to suffer?!

speaker: Severin
content: ...So what should we do?

raw: [name="Severin"]  Lock our doors and send them away? Lie to them? Tell them Dr. Atro took some Oripathy patients out on a hike?
speaker: Severin
content: Lock our doors and send them away? Lie to them? Tell them Dr. Atro took some Oripathy patients out on a hike?

raw: [name="Councilor"]  I know we can't sweep it under the rug. But you don't have the final say in this. We have to prepare for the worst.
speaker: Councilor
content: I know we can't sweep it under the rug. But you don't have the final say in this. We have to prepare for the worst.

raw: [name="Severin"]  No one has the final say on the truth, but... Never mind. Do as you will.
speaker: Severin
content: No one has the final say on the truth, but... Never mind. Do as you will.

speaker: Severin
content: I'm leaving.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  Leaving? Where are you going this time?
speaker: Councilor
content: Leaving? Where are you going this time?

speaker: Severin
content: ...I have a problem to solve.

raw: [name="Severin"]  My only job is to get this town back on track. The decision-making process? I have little patience for your political games.
speaker: Severin
content: My only job is to get this town back on track. The decision-making process? I have little patience for your political games.

speaker: Councilor
content: Hey! Wait!

raw: [name="Councilor"]  I know you're suffering, and there's so much we could've done better, but we had no choice!
speaker: Councilor
content: I know you're suffering, and there's so much we could've done better, but we had no choice!

raw: [name="Severin"]  I understand. That's why I'm still talking to you nice and peacefully.
speaker: Severin
content: I understand. That's why I'm still talking to you nice and peacefully.

raw: [name="Severin"]  I'll leave Rhodes Island to you. You're good at these things. I'll walk the blocks.
speaker: Severin
content: I'll leave Rhodes Island to you. You're good at these things. I'll walk the blocks.

speaker: Severin
content: That's the deal.

speaker: Councilor

speaker: Councilor

speaker: Councilor

raw: [name="Councilor"]  Forget it. Tatjana, Severin, Thor. They're all tragic figures, really.

raw: [name="Councilor"]  Let's get this place cleaned up. Rhodes Island will be here soon.

content: Let's get this place cleaned up. Rhodes Island will be here soon.
